text: DEFONEOS — FCDO Foreign Affairs & Diplomacy AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for FCDO foreign affairs & diplomacy systems. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × FCDO × Diplomatic Network × Development Aid FCDO Foreign Affairs & Diplomacy AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — covering 280+ diplomatic posts, £12.8bn ODA, sanctions enforcement, crisis response, and multilateral diplomacy across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Diplomatic 1. Diplomatic Network 280+ posts worldwide — embassies, high commissions, consular services, crisis evacuation coordination. Network operations, staffing, security vetting, secure comms infrastructure, host-government liaison, diplomatic bag handling, and visa processing across every continent. Policy 2. Foreign Policy Sanctions regimes via OFSI, treaty negotiations, UN/G7/G20 engagement, human rights reporting. Strategic policy development, sanctions design, diplomatic demarches, country policy briefs, and Foreign Secretary advisory pipeline covering 195 nations. Development 3. Development Aid ODA budget £12.8bn, FCDO programme delivery, humanitarian response, ICAI oversight, British International Investment (BII). Aid effectiveness measurement, partner country coordination, multilateral disbursement, and results-based financing across 150+ recipient nations. Trade 4. Trade Policy FTAs (Australia, Japan, CPTPP), export controls, NSI Act investment screening. Trade barrier resolution, market access negotiation, investor protection, strategic trade licensing for dual-use goods, and WTO dispute settlement coordination. Security 5. International Security CSSF conflict stabilisation fund, peacekeeping operations, non-proliferation (NPT/OPCW), cyber diplomacy, maritime security. Counter-terrorism cooperation, arms control verification, security sector reform, and defence engagement across priority regions. Climate 6. Climate Diplomacy COP legacy leadership, NDC commitments, loss & damage fund, green finance mobilisation, Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JETPs). Climate vulnerability assessments for ODA recipients, adaptation finance tracking, and Nature-Based Solutions deployment. Intelligence 7. Open Source Intelligence Research Analysts network, horizon scanning, OSINT collection, disinformation detection. Fuse open sources across 280+ posts into actionable intelligence for policy and crisis decisions. Includes social media monitoring, satellite imagery analysis, and media monitoring. Digital 8. Digital & Technology Virtual embassies, GovTech for development, cyber capacity building, AI governance diplomacy. Digital infrastructure in fragile states, internet freedom, responsible AI international norms, and digital identity for displaced populations. Identity 9. Passports & Nationality HMPO operations, British nationality law, Emergency Travel Document (ETD) issuance, fraud detection. Passport processing, citizenship verification, identity management for nationals abroad, and nationality casework for complex heritage claims. Crisis 10. Crisis Response Rapid Deployment Team (RDT), consular crisis operations, evacuation planning, COBR coordination. Natural disasters, conflict zones, terrorism events, mass casualty incidents affecting UK nationals, and repatriation logistics for stranded citizens. Multilateral 11. Multilateral Governance UN system engagement, Commonwealth coordination, international organisations, multilateral development banks. Voting blocs, leadership bids, assessed contributions, institutional reform advocacy, and treaty body reporting across the multilateral system. Accountability 12. Parliamentary Accountability Foreign Affairs Select Committee, FCDO Questions, Freedom of Information request
